findings.evidence: Mathlib precedent for exactly this: `upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/PicardGroup.lean:629: theorem tensorProductComm_eq_refl : TensorProduct.comm R M M = .refl ..` (in namespace `Module.Invertible`, i.e. outside `TensorProduct`). findings.fix: Rename to `tensorProductComm_mul_spinSingletProj` / `tensorProductComm_mul_spinTripletProj` (naming-conventions: a namespaced definition keeps its namespace prepended in lowerCamelCase when the bare name is ambiguous), and update the `## Main results` entry at line 60 and the proof references at lines 211 and 221.
findings.issue: `comm_mul_spinSingletProj` (line 188) and `comm_mul_spinTripletProj` (line 198) use bare `comm` for `TensorProduct.comm`. Their full names are `EpsilonEridani.QFT.Quarkonium.comm_mul_spinSingletProj`, where `comm` is the reserved axiomatic word for commutativity (naming-conventions, "Axiomatic descriptions": `comm`, `assoc`, `left_comm`), so the name reads as a commutativity lemma about `*` — `add_comm` is used with that meaning in this same file at line 144.

findings.evidence: Statement at lines 47-51 is `∑ i : Fin 3, TensorProduct.map (toEuclideanLin (pauliMatrix (Sum.inr i))) …`; the `_inr`/`pauliMatrix` segments match Physlib precedent (`upstream/Physlib/Physlib/Relativity/PauliMatrices/Basic.lean:58 pauliMatrix_inl_zero_eq_one`, `:86 pauliMatrix_mul_self`), only the `map` segment is ambiguous.
findings.fix: Rename to `sum_tensorProductMap_toEuclideanLin_pauliMatrix_inr` (or otherwise disambiguate the `TensorProduct.map` factor), and update the `## Main results` line 31 plus the cross-references in `SpinDecomposition.lean` lines 35 and 286.
findings.issue: Same defect in `PauliMatrix.sum_map_toEuclideanLin_pauliMatrix_inr`: `map` is the namespace-stripped `TensorProduct.map`, but a `map_` segment in a Mathlib-style name means application of a morphism (`map_add`, `map_sum`), and `sum_map` already has an unrelated meaning (`Finset.prod_map`/`sum_map`, `upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/BigOperators/Group/Finset/Defs.lean:395`). The name is upstream-bound (`PauliMatrix` namespace, PhyslibAlpha-eligible), so the ambiguity is permanent.

summary: Names mostly mirror the sibling `ColorDecomposition.lean` well, but two declarations strip the `TensorProduct` namespace off `comm` and `map`, producing globally ambiguous names that read as commutativity/morphism-map lemmas.
